## Problem and issue context

Link the real issue and describe the concrete problem. Use `Closes #N` only for completed
scope. For standalone work, write a concrete paragraph beginning with `Standalone:`.

## Changes and acceptance scope

Describe what this diff implements, relevant acceptance checks, and any remaining work.
Link existing or competing implementations and explain the useful difference, when relevant.

## Verification

List exact commands/checks and results, including denial/failure cases where relevant.
State live verification performed and anything still unverified. Passing syntax or CI alone
does not prove issue completion. Explain documentation/test-only verification when applicable.

## Compatibility and policy

Name any dependencies, version/contract changes, affected consumers, migrations or recovery
steps, and relevant constitution checks. Describe AI assistance accurately when used.

Review the [PR triage policy](https://github.com/AstralDeep/AstralDeep/blob/main/.github/PR_TRIAGE.md). Missing context requests clarification;
maintainers close only source-verified no-op, unsupported, duplicate, or superseded work.
